title: podcasts show/{showId}.json — our own episode list for one open-RSS catalog show (SR-04)
description: Written by tools/build_catalog.py for every open-RSS show in index.json (never for RTHK rows), from the publisher RSS the harvester already validates daily. Metadata only: no audio, no RSS body, no description. Enforced by build_catalog.show_list_errors().

showId.description: equals the id in the path and the key in index.json shows; a mismatch makes the file invalid

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 with offset (index.json format) of the build that produced this list; unchanged while the list is unchanged

episodes.description: newest first by publish time (ties keep feed order); only items with an audio enclosure and a parseable publish date

date.description: Hong Kong calendar date of the publish time

guid.description: the item's <guid>, trimmed; omitted when blank
